info.description:
**Autonomous AI Software Engineering Platform API**

AAISE v6 provides a complete API for automating software development from
natural language prompts to production deployments.

## Features
- Natural language to PRD generation
- Automated UI/UX design
- Multi-language code generation
- Comprehensive testing
- Security scanning
- Performance optimization
- GitOps deployment

## Authentication
All API requests require a valid JWT token in the Authorization header:
```
Authorization: Bearer <your-jwt-token>
```

## Rate Limiting
- 100 requests per minute per user
- 1000 requests per hour per organization

## Regions
- Lagos (af-south-1)
- London (eu-west-2)
- Ashburn (us-east-1)
